name: Madame Medusa - Deceiving Partner
en:
DOUBLE-CROSS When you play this character,
you may deal 2 damage to another chosen
character of yours to return chosen character
with cost 2 or less to their player's hand.
zh: 雙重背叛　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對你另一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害，來將一個費用 2 或以下的指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Hades - Ruthless Tyrant
en:
SHORT ON PATIENCE When you play this
character and whenever he quests, you may deal
2 damage to another chosen character of yours to
draw 2 cards.
zh: 沒有耐心　當你打出這個角色以及每當他探險時，你可以對你另一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害，來抽兩張牌。

name: Lena Sabrewing - Pure Energy
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SUPERNATURAL VENGEANCE ⟳ — Deal 1 damage
to chosen character.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
超自然復仇　⟳ — 對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Abu - Illusory Pachyderm
en:
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character
for an action, banish them.)
GRASPING TRUNK Whenever this character
quests, gain lore equal to the ◊ of chosen
opposing character.
zh:
消散（當對手為了行動而選擇這個角色時，消滅他們。）
抓握之鼻　每當這個角色探險時，獲得等同指定對方角色 ◊ 的傳說值。

name: Bruno Madrigal - Single-Minded
en:
STANDING TALL When you play this character,
chosen opposing character can't ready at the
start of their next turn.
zh: 昂首挺立　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Royal Guard - Octopus Soldier
en:
HEAVILY ARMED Whenever you draw a card, this
character gains Challenger +1 this turn. (They get
+1 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 重裝武備　每當你抽一張牌時，這個角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +1。（他們挑戰時獲得 +1 ¤。）

name: Kuzco - Bored Royal
en:
LLAMA BREATH When you play this character, you
may return chosen character, item, or location
with cost 2 or less to their player's hand.
zh: 駱馬吐息　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一個費用 2 或以下的指定角色、物品或地點移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Megara - Part of the Plan
en:
CONTENTIOUS ALLIANCE While you have a character
named Hades in play, this character gains Challenger +2.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 爭議聯盟　當你有一個名為 Hades 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Yelana - Northuldra Leader
en:
WE ONLY TRUST NATURE When you play this
character, chosen character gains Challenger +2
this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 我們只信任自然　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Ryder - Fleet-Footed Infiltrator
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Elsa - Fierce Protector
en:
ICE OVER 1 ⬡, Choose and discard a card — Exert
chosen opposing character.
zh: 冰封　1 ⬡，選擇並棄掉一張卡 — 橫置指定的對方角色。

name: Pinocchio - Strings Attached
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
GOT TO KEEP REAL QUIET Once during your turn,
whenever you ready this character, you may draw
a card.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
必須保持安靜　你回合中一次，每當你準備這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Jiminy Cricket - Level-Headed and Wise
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
ENOUGH'S ENOUGH While this character is
exerted, opposing characters with Rush enter
play exerted.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
夠了就是夠了　當這個角色橫置時，具突襲的對方角色橫置進場。

name: Bambi - Little Prince
en:
SAY HELLO When you play this character, gain 1 lore.
KIND OF BASHFUL When an opponent plays a
character, return this character to your hand.
zh:
打招呼　當你打出這個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。
有點害羞　當對手打出一個角色時，將這個角色移回你的手牌。

name: Monstro - Infamous Whale
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
FULL BREACH Choose and discard a card — Ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
完全躍出　選擇並棄掉一張卡 — 準備這個角色。他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Nero - Fearsome Crocodile
en:
AND MEAN ⟳ — Move 1 damage counter from
this character to chosen opposing character.
zh: 而且刻薄　⟳ — 將 1 個傷害指示物從這個角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Magica De Spell - Shadow Form
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
DANCE OF DARKNESS When you play this
character, you may return another chosen
character of yours to your hand to draw a card.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
黑暗之舞　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你另一個指定角色移回你的手牌來抽一張牌。

name: Kuzco - Impulsive Llama
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Kuzco.)
WHAT DOES THIS DO? When you play this character, each
opponent chooses one of their characters and puts that
card on the bottom of their deck. Then, each opponent may
draw a card.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Kuzco 的角色上。）
這是做什麼的？　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手選擇其一個角色並將該卡放到其牌庫底。然後，每位對手可以抽一張牌。

name: Yzma - On Edge
en:
WHY DO WE EVEN HAVE THAT LEVER? When you
play this character, if you have a card named Pull
the Lever! in your discard, you may search your
deck for a card named Wrong Lever! and reveal
that card to all players. Put that card into your
hand and shuffle your deck.
zh: 我們幹嘛要有那根拉桿？　當你打出這個角色時，若你的棄牌堆中有一張名為 Pull the Lever! 的卡，你可以在你的牌庫中搜尋一張名為 Wrong Lever! 的卡並向所有玩家展示。將該卡加入你的手牌並洗你的牌庫。

name: Madam Mim - Rhino
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Madam Mim.)
MAKE WAY, COMING THROUGH! When you play
this character, banish her or return another
chosen character of yours to your hand.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Madam Mim 的角色上。）
讓開，借過！　當你打出這個角色時，消滅她，或將你另一個指定角色移回你的手牌。

name: Mother Gothel - Knows What's Best
en:
LOOK WHAT YOU'VE DONE When you play this character,
you may deal 2 damage to another chosen character of
yours to give that character Challenger +1 and “When this
character is banished in a challenge, return this card to
your hand” this turn. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 看看你做了什麼　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對你另一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害，來給予該角色本回合挑戰者 +1 和「當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，將這張卡移回你的手牌」。（他們挑戰時獲得 +1 ¤。）

name: Blue Fairy - Guiding Light
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Anna - Magical Mission
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Anna.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
COORDINATED PLAN Whenever this character quests, if you
have a character named Elsa in play, you may draw a card.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Anna 的角色上。）
支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）
協調計畫　每當這個角色探險時，若你有一個名為 Elsa 的角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。

name: The Sultan - Royal Apparition
en:
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character
for an action, banish them.)
COMMANDING PRESENCE Whenever one of your
Illusion characters quests, exert chosen opposing
character.
zh:
消散（當對手為了行動而選擇這個角色時，消滅他們。）
威嚴氣勢　每當你一個幻象角色探險時，橫置指定的對方角色。

name: Jafar - High Sultan of Lorcana
en:
DARK POWER Whenever this character quests,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard a
card. If an Illusion character card is discarded this
way, you may play that character for free.
zh: 黑暗之力　每當這個角色探險時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。若你以此方式棄掉一張幻象角色卡，你可以免費打出該角色。

name: Camilo Madrigal - Center Stage
en:
ENCORE! ENCORE! When this character is banished
in a challenge, return this card to your hand.
zh: 安可！安可！　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，將這張卡移回你的手牌。

name: Flower - Shy Skunk
en:
LOOKING FOR FRIENDS Whenever you play another
character, look at the top card of your deck. Put it
on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
zh: 尋找朋友　每當你打出另一個角色時，查看你牌庫頂的卡。將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Forest Duel
en:
Your characters gain Challenger +2 and “When this
character is banished in a challenge, return this
card to your hand” this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while
challenging.)
zh: 你的角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2 和「當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，將這張卡移回你的手牌」。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: They Never Come Back
en:
Up to 2 chosen characters can't ready at the start of
their next turn. Draw a card.
zh: 至多 2 個指定角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。抽一張牌。

name: Fantastical and Magical
en:
Sing Together 9 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 9 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
For each character that sang this song, draw a card
and gain 1 lore.
zh:
合唱 9（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 9 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每有一個角色詠唱了這首歌，就抽一張牌並獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Pull the Lever!
en:
Choose one:
• Draw 2 cards.
• Each opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh:
選擇一項：
• 抽兩張牌。
• 每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Into the Unknown
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen exerted character into their player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定的橫置角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Everybody's Got a Weakness
en:
Move 1 damage counter from each damaged character
you have in play to chosen opposing character. Draw a
card for each damage counter moved this way.
zh: 將你在場每個受傷角色身上的 1 個傷害指示物移到指定的對方角色。以此方式每移動 1 個傷害指示物就抽一張牌。

name: Scarab
en:
SEARCH THE SANDS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Return an Illusion
character card from your discard to your hand.
zh: 搜索沙地　⟳，2 ⬡ — 將一張幻象角色卡從你的棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Ice Spikes
en:
HOLD STILL When you play this item, exert chosen
opposing character.
IT'S STUCK ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Exert chosen opposing item.
It can't ready at the start of its next turn.
zh:
別動　當你打出這個物品時，橫置指定的對方角色。
卡住了　⟳，1 ⬡ — 橫置指定的對方物品。它在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Basil - Undercover Detective
en:
INCAPACITATE When you play this character, you
may return chosen character to their player's hand.
INTERFERE Whenever this character quests, chosen
opponent discards a card at random.
zh:
使其失能　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。
干擾　每當這個角色探險時，指定對手隨機棄掉一張卡。

name: Tramp - Observant Guardian
en:
HOW DO I GET IN? When you play this character, chosen
character gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh: 我要怎麼進去？　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Chaca - Junior Chipmunk
en:
IN CAHOOTS When you play this character, if
you have a character named Tipo in play, chosen
opposing character gains Reckless during their next
turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
zh: 同謀　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個名為 Tipo 的角色在場，指定的對方角色在其下個回合獲得魯莽。（他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Tipo - Junior Chipmunk
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Bill the Lizard - Chimney Sweep
en:
NOTHING TO IT While another character in play
has damage, this character gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 輕而易舉　當場上有另一個帶傷害的角色時，這個角色獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: March Hare - Hare-Brained Eccentric
en:
LIGHT THE CANDLES When you play this
character, you may deal 2 damage to chosen
damaged character.
zh: 點燃蠟燭　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定的受傷角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Fred - Major Science Enthusiast
en:
SPITTING FIRE! When you play this character, you
may banish chosen item.
zh: 噴火！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Mad Dog - Karnage's First Mate
en:
ARE YOU SURE THIS IS SAFE, CAPTAIN? If you have a
character named Don Karnage in play, you pay 1 ⬡
less to play this character.
zh: 船長，你確定這安全嗎？　若你有一個名為 Don Karnage 的角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Louis - Endearing Alligator
en:
SENSITIVE SOUL This character enters play exerted.
FRIENDLIER THAN HE LOOKS When you play this
character, chosen opposing character gains Reckless
during their next turn. (They can't quest and must
challenge if able.)
zh:
敏感的靈魂　這個角色橫置進場。
比看起來友善　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合獲得魯莽。（他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Chip - Quick Thinker
en:
I'LL HANDLE THIS When you play this character,
chosen opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh: 這個交給我　當你打出這個角色時，指定對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Fred - Giant-Sized
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Fred.)
I LIKE WHERE THIS IS HEADING Whenever this character
quests, reveal cards from the top of your deck until you
reveal a Floodborn character card. Put that card into
your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Fred 的角色上。）
我喜歡這個發展　每當這個角色探險時，從你牌庫頂展示卡片直到展示出一張 Floodborn 角色卡。將該卡加入你的手牌，其餘的洗回你的牌庫。

name: Gadget Hackwrench - Quirky Scientist
en:
GOLLY! When you play this character, if an
opponent has more cards in their hand than you,
you may draw a card.
zh: 天啊！　當你打出這個角色時，若對手手牌比你多，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Raya - Infiltration Expert
en:
UNCONVENTIONAL TACTICS Whenever this
character quests, you may pay 2 ⬡ to ready
another chosen character.
zh: 非常規戰術　每當這個角色探險時，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 準備另一個指定角色。

name: Rapunzel - High Climber
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
WRAPPED UP Whenever this character quests,
chosen opposing character can't quest during
their next turn.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
纏繞　每當這個角色探險時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合不能探險。

name: Flynn Rider - Breaking and Entering
en:
THIS IS A VERY BIG DAY Whenever this character
is challenged, the challenging player may choose
and discard a card. If they don't, you gain 2 lore.
zh: 今天是重要的一天　每當這個角色被挑戰時，進行挑戰的玩家可以選擇並棄掉一張卡。若他們不這麼做，你獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Dormouse - Easily Agitated
en:
VERY RUDE INDEED When you play this character,
you may put 1 damage counter on chosen
character.
zh: 真是無禮　當你打出這個角色時，你可以在指定角色上放置 1 個傷害指示物。

name: Alice - Clumsy as Can Be
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Alice.)
ACCIDENT PRONE Whenever this character
quests, put 1 damage counter on each other
character.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Alice 的角色上。）
容易出意外　每當這個角色探險時，在每個其他角色上放置 1 個傷害指示物。

name: Queen of Hearts - Haughty Monarch
en:
COUNT OFF! While there are 5 or more characters
with damage in play, this character gets +3 ◊.
zh: 報數！　當場上有 5 個或以上的帶傷害角色時，這個角色獲得 +3 ◊。

name: Hiro Hamada - Intuitive Thinker
en:
LOOK FOR A NEW ANGLE ⟳ — Ready chosen
Floodborn character.
zh: 尋找新角度　⟳ — 準備指定的 Floodborn 角色。

name: Go Go Tomago - Cutting Edge
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Go Go Tomago.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
ZERO RESISTANCE When you play this character, if you used
Shift to play her, you may put chosen character into their
player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Go Go Tomago 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
零阻力　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出她，你可以將指定角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Don Karnage - Air Pirate Leader
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SCORNFUL TAUNT Whenever you play an action
that isn't a song, chosen opposing character gains
Reckless during their next turn. (They can't quest
and must challenge if able.)
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
輕蔑嘲諷　每當你打出一個非歌曲的行動時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合獲得魯莽。（他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Captain Hook - The Pirate King
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Captain Hook.)
GIVE 'EM ALL YOU GOT! Once during your turn,
whenever an opposing character takes damage, your
Pirate characters get +2 ¤ and gain Resist +2 this
turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Captain Hook 的角色上。）
全力以赴！　你回合中一次，每當有對方角色受到傷害時，你的海盜角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤ 和抵抗 +2。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Maui - Stubborn Trickster
en:
I'M NOT FINISHED YET When this character is banished,
choose one:
• Put 2 damage counters on all opposing characters.
• Banish all opposing items.
• Banish all opposing locations.
zh:
我還沒完　當這個角色被消滅時，選擇一項：
• 在所有對方角色上放置 2 個傷害指示物。
• 消滅所有對方物品。
• 消滅所有對方地點。

name: Honey Lemon - Costumed Catalyst
en:
LET'S DO THIS! Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, if you used Shift to play them, you may
return chosen character to their player's hand.
zh: 動手吧！　每當你打出一個 Floodborn 角色時，若你以變身打出他們，你可以將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Jock - Attentive Uncle
en:
VOICE OF EXPERIENCE When you play this character, if
you have 3 or more other characters in play, gain 2 lore.
zh: 經驗之聲　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有 3 個或以上的角色在場，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Archimedes - Resourceful Owl
en:
YOU DON'T NEED THAT When you play this
character, you may banish chosen item.
NOW, THAT'S NOT BAD During your turn,
whenever an item is banished, you may draw a
card, then choose and discard a card.
zh:
你不需要那個　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。
那還不錯　在你的回合中，每當有物品被消滅時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: He Who Steals and Runs Away
en: Banish chosen item. Draw a card.
zh: 消滅指定的物品。抽一張牌。

name: Stopped Chaos in Its Tracks
en:
Sing Together 8 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 8 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Return up to 2 chosen characters with 3 ¤ or less
each to their player's hand.
zh:
合唱 8（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 8 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將至多 2 個各 3 ¤ 或以下的指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Wrong Lever!
en:
Choose one:
• Return chosen character to their player's hand.
• Put a card named Pull the Lever! from your discard on
the bottom of your deck to put chosen character on
the bottom of their player's deck.
zh:
選擇一項：
• 將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。
• 將你棄牌堆中一張名為 Pull the Lever! 的卡放到你牌庫底，來將指定角色放到其持有者的牌庫底。

name: Undermine
en:
Chosen opponent chooses and discards a card. Chosen
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 指定對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。指定角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Walk the Plank!
en:
Your Pirate characters gain “⟳ — Banish chosen
damaged character” this turn.
zh: 你的海盜角色本回合獲得「⟳ — 消滅指定的受傷角色」。

name: Chem Purse
en:
HERE'S THE BEST PART Whenever you play a character,
if you used Shift to play them, they get +4 ¤ this turn.
zh: 這是最棒的部分　每當你打出一個角色時，若你以變身打出他們，他們本回合獲得 +4 ¤。

name: Jeweled Collar
en:
WELCOME EXTRAVAGANCE Whenever one of your
characters is challenged, you may put the top card of
your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 歡迎奢華　每當你一個角色被挑戰時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Gloyd Orangeboar - Fierce Competitor
en:
PUMPKIN SPICE When you play this character,
each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
zh: 南瓜香料　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Gyro Gearloose - Eccentric Inventor
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
I'LL SHOW YOU! When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -3 ¤ this turn.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
我秀給你看！　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -3 ¤。

name: Vanellope von Schweetz - Spunky Speedster
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Brutus - Fearsome Crocodile
en:
SPITEFUL During your turn, when this character
is banished, if one of your characters took damage
this turn, gain 2 lore.
zh: 懷恨　在你的回合中，當這個角色被消滅時，若你一個角色本回合受到過傷害，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: The Dodo - Outlandish Storyteller
en:
EXTRAORDINARY SITUATION This character gets
+1 ¤ for each 1 damage on him.
zh: 非凡的處境　他身上每有 1 點傷害，這個角色就獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Alice - Courageous Keyholder
en:
THIS WAY OUT When you play this character, you
may ready chosen damaged character of yours.
They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 這邊出去　當你打出這個角色時，你可以準備你一個指定的受傷角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Lumiere - Nimble Candelabra
en:
QUICK-STEP While you have an item card in
your discard, this character gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 快步　當你的棄牌堆中有一張物品卡時，這個角色獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Gaston - Arrogant Showoff
en:
BREAK APART When you play this character, you
may banish one of your items to give chosen
character +2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 拆開　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅你一個物品，來給予指定角色本回合 +2 ¤。

name: Mushu - Fast-Talking Dragon
en:
LET'S GET THIS SHOW ON THE ROAD ⟳ — Chosen
character gains Rush this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played.)
zh: 讓表演開始吧　⟳ — 指定角色本回合獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Cri-Kee - Part of the Team
en:
AT HER SIDE While you have 2 or more other exerted
characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh: 在她身邊　當你另有 2 個或以上橫置的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Figaro - Tuxedo Cat
en: PLAYFULNESS Opposing items enter play exerted.
zh: 玩心　對方的物品橫置進場。

name: Thumper - Young Bunny
en:
YOU CAN DO IT! ⟳ — Chosen character gets +3 ¤
this turn.
zh: 你做得到！　⟳ — 指定角色本回合獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Wreck-It Ralph - Back Seat Driver
en:
CHARGED UP When you play this character,
chosen Racer character gets +4 ¤ this turn.
zh: 充飽電　當你打出這個角色時，指定的賽車手角色本回合獲得 +4 ¤。

name: Tinker Bell - Insistent Fairy
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
PAY ATTENTION Whenever you play a character with
5 ¤ or more, you may exert them to gain 2 lore.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
注意　每當你打出一個 5 ¤ 或以上的角色時，你可以橫置他們來獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Lilo - Causing an Uproar
en:
STOMPIN' TIME! During your turn, if you've played
3 or more actions this turn, you may play this
character for free.
RAAAWR! When you play this character, ready
chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of
this turn.
zh:
跺腳時間！　在你的回合中，若你本回合打出過 3 個或以上的行動，你可以免費打出這個角色。
吼！　當你打出這個角色時，準備指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: LeFou - Cake Thief
en:
ALL FOR ME ⟳, Banish one of your items —
Chosen opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
zh: 全都是我的　⟳，消滅你一個物品 — 指定對手失去 1 點傳說值，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Lumiere - Fired Up
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Lumiere.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
SACREBLEU! Whenever one of your items is
banished, this character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Lumiere 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
該死！　每當你一個物品被消滅時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: The Coachman - Greedy Deceiver
en:
WILD RIDE While 2 or more characters of yours
are exerted, this character gets +2 ¤ and
gains Evasive. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
zh: 狂野旅程　當你有 2 個或以上橫置的角色時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤ 並獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Mulan - Charging Ahead
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
BURST OF SPEED During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
LONG RANGE This character can challenge ready
characters.
zh:
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）
爆發速度　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）
遠程　這個角色可以挑戰已準備的角色。

name: Mushu - Your Worst Nightmare
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mushu.)
ALL FIRED UP Whenever you play another character, they
gain Rush, Reckless, and Evasive this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played. They can't quest and
must challenge if able. They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mushu 的角色上。）
全面點燃　每當你打出另一個角色時，他們本回合獲得突襲、魯莽和迴避。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Mr. Snoops - Betrayed Partner
en:
DOUBLE-CROSSING CROOK! During your turn, when
this character is banished, you may draw a card.
zh: 雙面騙子！　在你的回合中，當這個角色被消滅時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Faline - Playful Fawn
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
PRECOCIOUS FRIEND While you have a character
in play with more ¤ than each opposing
character, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
早熟的朋友　當你有一個 ¤ 比每個對方角色都高的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Prince John - Fraidy-Cat
en:
HELP! HELP! Whenever an opponent plays a
character, deal 1 damage to this character.
zh: 救命！救命！　每當對手打出一個角色時，對這個角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Nothing We Won't Do
en:
Sing Together 8 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 8 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Ready all your characters. For the rest of this turn,
they take no damage from challenges and can't quest.
zh:
合唱 8（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 8 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
準備你所有的角色。本回合剩餘時間內，他們不受挑戰的傷害且不能探險。

name: Get Out!
en:
Banish chosen character, then return an item card
from your discard to your hand.
zh: 消滅指定角色，然後將一張物品卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。

name: Light the Fuse
en:
Deal 1 damage to chosen character for each exerted
character you have in play.
zh: 你在場每有一個橫置的角色，就對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Twitterpated
en:
Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next
turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Most Everyone's Mad Here
en:
Gain lore equal to the damage on chosen character,
then banish them.
zh: 獲得等同指定角色身上傷害的傳說值，然後消滅他們。

name: The Sword of Shan-Yu
en:
WORTHY WEAPON ⟳, ⟳ one of your characters —
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.
zh: 值得的武器　⟳，橫置你一個角色 — 準備指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Sir Pellinore - Seasoned Knight
en:
CODE OF HONOR Whenever this character quests,
your other characters gain Support this turn.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to
another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 榮譽準則　每當這個角色探險時，你其他的角色本回合獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Anita Radcliffe - Dog Lover
en:
I'LL TAKE CARE OF YOU When you play this
character, you may give chosen Puppy character
Resist +1 until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 我會照顧你　當你打出這個角色時，你可以給予指定的幼犬角色抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Olaf - Recapping the Story
en:
ENDLESS TALE When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -1 ¤ this turn.
zh: 無盡故事　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -1 ¤。

name: Anna - Trusting Sister
en:
WE CAN DO THIS TOGETHER When you play this
character, if you have a character named Elsa in
play, you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 我們可以一起做到　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個名為 Elsa 的角色在場，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Wasabi - Always Prepared
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Go Go Tomago - Mechanical Engineer
en:
NEED THIS! When you play a Floodborn character
on this card, you may put the top card of your
deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 需要這個！　當你在這張卡上打出一個 Floodborn 角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: The Wardrobe - Perceptive Friend
en:
I HAVE JUST THE THING! ⟳, Choose and discard
an item card — Draw 2 cards.
zh: 我正好有！　⟳，選擇並棄掉一張物品卡 — 抽兩張牌。

name: Mrs. Potts - Head Housekeeper
en: CLEAN UP ⟳, Banish one of your items — Draw a card.
zh: 清理　⟳，消滅你一個物品 — 抽一張牌。

name: Jasmine - Resourceful Infiltrator
en:
JUST WHAT YOU NEED When you play this
character, you may give another chosen character
Resist +1 until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 正好你需要的　當你打出這個角色時，你可以給予另一個指定角色抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Little Sister - Responsible Rabbit
en:
LET ME HELP When you play this character,
you may remove up to 1 damage from chosen
character.
zh: 讓我幫忙　當你打出這個角色時，你可以從指定角色身上移除至多 1 點傷害。

name: Nani - Heist Mastermind
en:
STICK TO THE PLAN ⟳ — Another chosen character
gains Resist +2 this turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
IT'S UP TO YOU, LILO Your characters named Lilo gain
Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤
to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh:
照計畫走　⟳ — 另一個指定角色本回合獲得抵抗 +2。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）
看你的了，Lilo　你名為 Lilo 的角色獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Stitch - Experiment 626
en:
SO NAUGHTY When you play this character, each opponent
puts the top card of their deck into their inkwell facedown
and exerted.
STEALTH MODE At the start of your turn, if this card is in
your discard, you may choose and discard a card with ◉ to
play this character for free and he enters play exerted.
zh:
真頑皮　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手將其牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入其墨水池。
潛行模式　在你的回合開始時，若這張卡在你的棄牌堆中，你可以選擇並棄掉一張具 ◉ 的卡，來免費打出這個角色且他橫置進場。

name: Ratigan - Greedy Genius
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
TIME RUNS OUT At the end of your turn, if you
didn't put any cards into your inkwell this turn,
banish this character.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
時間耗盡　在你的回合結束時，若你本回合沒有把任何卡放入墨水池，消滅這個角色。

name: Arthur - Determined Squire
en: NO MORE BOOKS Skip your turn's Draw step.
zh: 不要再看書了　跳過你回合的抽牌步驟。

name: Bernard - Over-Prepared
en:
GO DOWN THERE AND INVESTIGATE When you play
this character, if you have an Ally character in
play, you may draw a card.
zh: 下去那裡調查　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個盟友角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Aladdin - Vigilant Guard
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
SAFE PASSAGE Whenever one of your Ally characters
quests, you may remove up to 2 damage from this
character.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
安全通行　每當你一個盟友角色探險時，你可以從這個角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。

name: Jasmine - Steady Strategist
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Jasmine.)
ALWAYS PLANNING Whenever this character quests,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal
an Ally character card and put it into your hand. Put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Jasmine 的角色上。）
總在計畫　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。你可以展示一張盟友角色卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Roquefort - Lock Expert
en:
SAFEKEEPING Whenever this character quests,
you may put chosen item into its player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
zh: 妥善保管　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將指定的物品牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Geppetto - Skilled Craftsman
en:
SEEKING INSPIRATION Whenever this character
quests, you may choose and discard any number
of item cards to gain 1 lore for each item card
discarded this way.
zh: 尋求靈感　每當這個角色探險時，你可以選擇並棄掉任意數量的物品卡，以此方式每棄掉一張物品卡就獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Heads Held High
en:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 6 or more may ⟳
to sing this song for free.)
Remove up to 3 damage from any number of chosen
characters. All opposing characters get -3 ¤ this turn.
zh:
合唱 6（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 6 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
從任意數量的指定角色身上移除至多 3 點傷害。所有對方角色本回合獲得 -3 ¤。

name: Pouncing Practice
en:
Chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn. Chosen
character of yours gains Evasive this turn. (They can
challenge characters with Evasive.)
zh: 撲擊練習　指定角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。你一個指定角色本回合獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Down in New Orleans
en:
(A character with cost 6 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a
character, item, or location card with cost 6 or less and
play it for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck
in any order.
zh:
（費用 6 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。你可以展示一張費用 6 或以下的角色、物品或地點卡並免費打出它。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Television Set
en:
IS IT ON YET? ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Look at the top card of your deck.
If it's a Puppy character card, you may reveal it and put it into
your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
zh: 播了嗎？　⟳，1 ⬡ — 查看你牌庫頂的卡。若它是幼犬角色卡，你可以展示它並加入手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

name: Belle's Favorite Book
en:
CHAPTER THREE ⟳, Banish one of your other items —
Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
zh: 第三章　⟳，消滅你另一個物品 — 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Atlantean Crystal
en:
SHIELDING LIGHT ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gains
Resist +2 and Support until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2. Whenever
they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 護盾之光　⟳，2 ⬡ — 指定角色獲得抵抗 +2 和支援，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Bobby - Purple Pigeon
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
zh: 護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Magic Carpet - Phantom Rug
en:
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character for
an action, banish them.)
SPECTRAL FORCE Your other Illusion characters gain
Challenger +1. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)
zh:
消散（當對手為了行動而選擇這個角色時，消滅他們。）
幽靈之力　你其他的幻象角色獲得挑戰者 +1。（他們挑戰時獲得 +1 ¤。）

name: Prince Achmed - Rival Suitor
en:
UNWELCOME PROPOSAL When you play this
character, you may exert chosen Princess
character.
zh: 不受歡迎的求婚　當你打出這個角色時，你可以橫置指定的公主角色。

name: Dumptruck - Karnage's Second Mate
en:
LET ME AT 'EM When you play this character, you
may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
zh: 讓我來對付他們　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Captain Hook - Forceful Duelist
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: General Li - Head of the Imperial Army
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh: 抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Monterey Jack - Defiant Protector
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
zh: 護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Genie - Satisfied Dragon
en:
BUG CATCHER During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
zh: 捕蟲者　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Toby Turtle - Wary Friend
en:
HARD SHELL While this character is exerted, he gains
Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 硬殼　當這個角色橫置時，他獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Zipper - Flying Ranger
en:
BEST MATES If you have a character named
Monterey Jack in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play
this character.
BURST OF SPEED During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
zh:
最佳夥伴　若你有一個名為 Monterey Jack 的角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
爆發速度　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Vinnie - Green Pigeon
en:
LEARNING EXPERIENCE During an opponent's turn,
whenever one of your other characters is banished,
gain 1 lore.
zh: 學習經驗　在對手的回合中，每當你另一個角色被消滅時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Iago - Out of Reach
en:
SELF-PRESERVATION While you have another
exerted character in play, this character can't be
challenged.
zh: 自保　當你另有一個橫置的角色在場時，這個角色不能被挑戰。

name: Nathaniel Flint - Notorious Pirate
en:
PREDATORY INSTINCT You can't play this character
unless an opposing character took damage this turn.
zh: 掠食本能　除非本回合有對方角色受到過傷害，否則你不能打出這個角色。

name: Vincenzo Santorini - The Explosives Expert
en:
I JUST LIKE TO BLOW THINGS UP When you play
this character, you may deal 3 damage to chosen
character.
zh: 我就是喜歡炸東西　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Namaari - Single-Minded Rival
en:
STRATEGIC EDGE When you play this character
and at the start of your turn, you may draw a card,
then choose and discard a card.
EXTREME FOCUS This character gets +1 ¤ for
each card in your discard.
zh:
策略優勢　當你打出這個角色以及在你的回合開始時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。
極度專注　你棄牌堆每有一張卡，這個角色就獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Mickey Mouse - Giant Mouse
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
THE BIGGEST STAR EVER When this character
is banished, deal 5 damage to each opposing
character.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
史上最大明星　當這個角色被消滅時，對每個對方角色造成 5 點傷害。

name: Stitch - Alien Troublemaker
en:
I WIN! During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you may
draw a card and gain 1 lore.
zh: 我贏了！　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以抽一張牌並獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Desperate Plan
en:
If you have no cards in your hand, draw until you have
3 cards in your hand. Otherwise, choose and discard
any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
zh: 若你手上沒有卡，抽牌直到你手牌有 3 張；否則，選擇並棄掉任意數量的卡，然後抽取相同數量的牌。

name: Beyond the Horizon
en:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 7 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Choose any number of players. They discard their
hands and draw 3 cards each.
zh:
合唱 7（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 7 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
選擇任意數量的玩家。他們棄掉手牌並各抽 3 張牌。

name: Quick Shot
en: Deal 1 damage to chosen character. Draw a card.
zh: 對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。抽一張牌。

name: Hamster Ball
en:
ROLL WITH THE PUNCHES ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character
with no damage gains Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh: 見招拆招　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定的無傷害角色獲得抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Lady - Decisive Dog
en:
PACK OF HER OWN Whenever you play a
character, this character gets +1 ¤ this turn.
TAKE THE LEAD While this character has 3 ¤
or more, she gets +2 ◊.
zh:
她自己的一群　每當你打出一個角色時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤。
帶頭　當這個角色有 3 ¤ 或以上時，她獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Wreck-It Ralph - Big Lug
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Wreck-It Ralph.)
BACK ON TRACK When you play this character
and whenever he quests, you may return a Racer
character card with cost 6 or less from your
discard to your hand. If you do, gain 1 lore.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Wreck-It Ralph 的角色上。）
重回正軌　當你打出這個角色以及每當他探險時，你可以將一張費用 6 或以下的賽車手角色卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。若你這麼做，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Perdita - Determined Mother
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Perdita.)
QUICK, EVERYONE HIDE When you play this
character, you may put all Puppy character cards
from your discard into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Perdita 的角色上。）
快，大家躲起來　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你棄牌堆中所有幼犬角色卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: It Means No Worries
en:
Sing Together 9 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 9 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Return up to 3 character cards from your discard to your
hand. You pay 2 ⬡ less for the next character you play
this turn.
zh:
合唱 9（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 9 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將至多 3 張角色卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。你本回合打出的下一個角色少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Bambi - Little Prince
en:
SAY HELLO When you play this character, gain
1 lore.
KIND OF BASHFUL When an opponent plays a
character, return this character to your hand.
zh:
打招呼　當你打出這個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。
有點害羞　當對手打出一個角色時，將這個角色移回你的手牌。

name: Kuzco - Impulsive Llama
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Kuzco.)
WHAT DOES THIS DO? When you play this character,
each opponent chooses one of their characters and
puts that card on the bottom of their deck. Then,
each opponent may draw a card.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Kuzco 的角色上。）
這是做什麼的？　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手選擇其一個角色並將該卡放到其牌庫底。然後，每位對手可以抽一張牌。

name: Mother Gothel - Knows What's Best
en:
LOOK WHAT YOU'VE DONE When you play this
character, you may deal 2 damage to another
chosen character of yours to give that character
Challenger +1 and “When this character is banished
in a challenge, return this card to your hand” this
turn. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 看看你做了什麼　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對你另一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害，來給予該角色本回合挑戰者 +1 和「當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，將這張卡移回你的手牌」。（他們挑戰時獲得 +1 ¤。）

name: Fantastical and Magical
en:
Sing Together 9 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 9 or more
may ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
For each character that sang this song, draw a
card and gain 1 lore.
zh:
合唱 9（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 9 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每有一個角色詠唱了這首歌，就抽一張牌並獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Into the Unknown
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen exerted character into their player's
inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定的橫置角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Rapunzel - High Climber
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
WRAPPED UP Whenever this character
quests, chosen opposing character can't
quest during their next turn.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
纏繞　每當這個角色探險時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合不能探險。

name: Captain Hook - The Pirate King
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Captain Hook.)
GIVE 'EM ALL YOU GOT! Once during your turn,
whenever an opposing character takes damage,
your Pirate characters get +2 ¤ and gain Resist +2
this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Captain Hook 的角色上。）
全力以赴！　你回合中一次，每當有對方角色受到傷害時，你的海盜角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤ 和抵抗 +2。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Wrong Lever!
en:
Choose one:
• Return chosen character to their player's hand.
• Put a card named Pull the Lever! from your discard
on the bottom of your deck to put chosen character
on the bottom of their player's deck.
zh:
選擇一項：
• 將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。
• 將你棄牌堆中一張名為 Pull the Lever! 的卡放到你牌庫底，來將指定角色放到其持有者的牌庫底。

name: Lilo - Causing an Uproar
en:
STOMPIN' TIME! During your turn, if you've
played 3 or more actions this turn, you may play
this character for free.
RAAAWR! When you play this character, ready
chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.
zh:
跺腳時間！　在你的回合中，若你本回合打出過 3 個或以上的行動，你可以免費打出這個角色。
吼！　當你打出這個角色時，準備指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Mushu - Your Worst Nightmare
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Mushu.)
ALL FIRED UP Whenever you play another character,
they gain Rush, Reckless, and Evasive this turn. (They
can challenge the turn they're played. They can't quest
and must challenge if able. They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mushu 的角色上。）
全面點燃　每當你打出另一個角色時，他們本回合獲得突襲、魯莽和迴避。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: The Sword of Shan-Yu
en:
WORTHY WEAPON ⟳, ⟳ one of your characters —
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the
rest of this turn.
zh: 值得的武器　⟳，橫置你一個角色 — 準備指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Stitch - Experiment 626
en:
SO NAUGHTY When you play this character, each
opponent puts the top card of their deck into their
inkwell facedown and exerted.
STEALTH MODE At the start of your turn, if this card is in
your discard, you may choose and discard a card with ◉
to play this character for free and he enters play exerted.
zh:
真頑皮　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手將其牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入其墨水池。
潛行模式　在你的回合開始時，若這張卡在你的棄牌堆中，你可以選擇並棄掉一張具 ◉ 的卡，來免費打出這個角色且他橫置進場。

name: Jasmine - Steady Strategist
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Jasmine.)
ALWAYS PLANNING Whenever this character quests,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal
an Ally character card and put it into your hand. Put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Jasmine 的角色上。）
總在計畫　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。你可以展示一張盟友角色卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Desperate Plan
en:
If you have no cards in your hand, draw until you
have 3 cards in your hand. Otherwise, choose and
discard any number of cards, then draw that many
cards.
zh: 若你手上沒有卡，抽牌直到你手牌有 3 張；否則，選擇並棄掉任意數量的卡，然後抽取相同數量的牌。

name: Goofy - Groundbreaking Chef
en:
PLENTY TO GO AROUND At the end of your turn,
you may remove up to 1 damage from each of
your other characters. Ready each character you
removed damage from this way.
zh: 足夠分配　在你的回合結束時，你可以從你每個其他角色身上移除至多 1 點傷害。準備每個你以此方式移除傷害的角色。

name: Pinocchio - Strings Attached
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
GOT TO KEEP REAL QUIET Once during your turn,
whenever you ready this character, you may draw
a card.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
必須保持安靜　你回合中一次，每當你準備這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌。
